invariantRules.rule: ProcedureDefinition and performed test never share identity; performed test is WM-ACT-033 execution-local.
Every performed test pins one authorised immutable procedure version and pinned criteria before evaluation.
Method, evidence, sampling or decision-rule change creates an immutable successor ProcedureVersion.
ProcedureDefinition owns no engagement, execution, finding, opinion, response, action or closure identity.
Population, frame, gaps, method, sample units and sampling cell are explicit on every performed test.
Evidence is bound to one performed test and sampling cell; observation alone is neither evidence nor finding.
Finding requires pinned criteria, cell-bound evidence and evaluation.
One-system or one-site evidence never extrapolates across an exclusion or frame gap.
Competence and independence requirements are separate and evidenced per engagement and execution.
Procedure completion, task completion, corrective action, management response and opinion never close a finding.
Retired and superseded versions remain immutable and resolvable for issued work.
A reusable definition is catalog-owned and is never cloned into an engagement or execution.
WM-KNW-012 masters criteria statements only; ProcedureVersion owns method steps; neither may contain the other's content.
At most one ProcedureVersion is effective per definition at an instant; supersedesVersion is required when a predecessor exists.
Every approved or effective version records approverRef and approvedAt; new pins require authorized, effective, non-suspended and non-withdrawn status at execution time; withdrawal is prospective.
Engagement criteria binding is mastered by WM-ECO-035; performed tests reference it read-only before evaluation and cannot diverge.
Performed-test sampling record owns population, frame, gap kinds, method code and version, sample units and size, deviations and explicit projection claim including none.
EvidenceItem is an identified provenance/integrity unit; EvidencePackage is a collection of item references; each reference binds test and cell and may reuse an item across tests.
Finding identity is an engagement-scoped unique key and remains stable through retest, response, closure and supersession.
Root cause is an evidenced WM-KNW-007-shaped claim with conclusion status including undetermined, distinct from finding, issue and action.
Event, execution, observation, issuance, response, action completion, retest and ingestion times are separate recorded fields.
